Class AvogadroApi

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.AvogadroApi
public final class AvogadroApi extends Object
Registers molecules and looks up the server's molecule definitions.

Use this API in code that can run on either a client or a dedicated server. For drawing models or exporting images, use the separate client API.
